### 🔧 Weapon surfaces
- Every weapon now has a real surface instead of a flat colour: wood grain running along stocks and hafts, worn parkerized steel on receivers and blades, mineral grit on stone tool heads, and a moulded pebble on rubber grips and polymer furniture.
- The AK's stock and handguard, the axe and pickaxe hafts, the shotgun's furniture and the bow's limbs all show their grain running the length of the wood, the way it would on the real thing.
- Knife grips, pistol grips and polymer housings pick up a fine moulded texture; the riot shield gets brushed metal running up the panel.
- Colours are unchanged — every surface still reads exactly as before at a distance.

### 🖼️ Browser tab
- Playing in the browser now shows the game's own icon in the tab instead of a blank page icon — the same one the desktop app and the website use.

### ⚡ Performance
- Fixed a freeze of up to two and a half seconds the first time a hotbar filled up with items, and the hitching that came with scrolling quickly through weapons. Switching weapons at speed now drops no frames at all.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Fixed the flickering surface between a magazine and the gun body — most visible on the AK — and the same fault in eight other places across the armoury: the M4's magazine, the shield's frame, the Deagle's trigger guard and rear sight, the Scout's stock, the shotgun's sight rib, the FAMAS's carry handle and the grenade launcher's chamber.
